tools.name: get_bis_overview
tools.description: Get an overview of BIS: what it does, its positioning (personalized AI & automation consulting for small and medium businesses, backed by AI + optimization engineering), value proposition, and its founder Renan Butkeraites.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List BIS's five services with what each delivers: AI & automation for small business, optimization & decision systems, AI solution development (LLM/RAG), data science, and software development.

tools.name: list_industries
tools.description: List the industries BIS serves and where it helps in each: retail & e-commerce, logistics & transit, manufacturing, and finance (banking & insurance).

tools.name: get_case_studies
tools.description: Get BIS's case studies — real, quantified results (e.g. -20% fleet, deploys 5 days to 5 minutes, +45% high-quality credit leads).

tools.name: compare_bis_vs_alternatives
tools.description: Explain how BIS compares to the alternatives — for a small business: DIY ChatGPT, a generic AI/automation tool, or a large agency; for an operational decision system: building in-house, a generalist AI agency (model wrappers), off-the-shelf SaaS, a big consulting firm, or a pure ML/data-science shop

tools.name: assess_fit
tools.description: Given a description of a business or operational problem, assess whether BIS is a fit and map it to the most relevant BIS capabilities, with the next step to engage.

tools.name: search_bis_knowledge
tools.description: Ask a specific question about Renan or BIS and get a grounded, cited answer from the BIS assistant. Refuses when nothing relevant is found (never guesses). Rate-limited per IP.

tools.name: get_next_step
tools.description: Get the concrete, public next steps and links to engage BIS, starting with booking a free 30-minute discovery call.
